stores.name: Best Buy
stores.short: Matches Amazon, Walmart, Target, Costco, Sam's, BJ's and more
stores.scope: Electronics and appliances. Identical item (same brand, model and color), in stock, sold directly by the other store.
stores.after: 15 days after you buy (30 days for My Best Buy Plus and Total members). Holiday buys Oct 31–Dec 31 can be adjusted through Jan 15.
stores.how: In store: show the ad, a screenshot or the live webpage. Online: BestBuy.com chat or call 1-888-BEST BUY (no email).
no: Marketplace sellers on Amazon or Walmart
Membership prices unless you're a member
Bundles, coupons and gift card deals

stores.name: Home Depot
stores.short: Matches Amazon, Lowe's, Walmart and other big stores
stores.scope: Identical, in-stock item. Amazon only counts when it's sold and shipped by Amazon.
stores.after: Ask at the service desk. Guides disagree on the window (30 days per Checkbook, longer in other guides).
stores.how: In store: show the ad or listing at the register or service desk. Online: chat or call 1-800-HOME-DEPOT with the link.

stores.name: Lowe's
stores.short: Matches Home Depot, Walmart, Menards and more
stores.scope: Identical, in-stock item. Local stores must be in your Lowe's ZIP. Amazon matches are for Lowes.com orders only.
stores.after: Up to 30 days after you buy, if a competitor or Lowe's drops the price. Some stores apply 14 days, so ask.
stores.how: Ask before checkout with a screenshot showing the link, model number, price and "in stock." Online: chat or call 1-877-465-6937.

stores.name: Staples
stores.short: Matches Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and Office Depot
stores.after: Up to 14 days after you buy.
stores.how: Show the lower price to an associate at checkout.
no: Check with the store for exclusions

stores.name: Kohl's
stores.short: Matches local stores with a printed ad; lots of exclusions
stores.scope: Identical item at a competitor with physical stores. Bring a printed ad. Online, only select store websites count.
stores.after: Kohl's adjusts its own price drops within 14 days with your receipt.
stores.how: Bring the printed ad to the register, or your receipt for a price adjustment.
no: Electronics, toys, footwear, athletic wear, beauty and more

stores.name: BJ's
stores.short: TVs only: matches Amazon, Best Buy, Costco, Sam's, Target, Walmart
stores.scope: Eligible TVs only. New in box, same brand, model and color, in stock at the other store.
stores.after: Same day only. Requests must be made on the day you buy.
stores.how: In club: member services desk with the ad or competitor's webpage. Online: call 1-800-BJS-CLUB or chat.

stores.name: Target
stores.short: No longer matches other stores. Matches its own lower prices for 14 days
stores.scope: Since July 28, 2025, Target only matches Target: a lower price at another Target, Target.com, the app or an eligible Target Circle deal.
stores.after: 14 days after you buy, if Target's own price drops.
stores.how: In store: show the lower Target price (screenshots may not count). Online: chat or call 1-800-591-3869.
no: Amazon, Walmart and every other store
Gift card and Circle bonus offers

stores.name: Walmart
stores.short: No competitor matching. In store, matches Walmart.com prices
stores.scope: In a Walmart store, staff can match a lower Walmart.com price on the identical, in-stock item. It doesn't match Amazon, Target or other stores.
stores.after: No price adjustments after you buy.
stores.how: Show the Walmart.com listing to a manager or at checkout.

stores.name: Costco
stores.short: No competitor matching, but refunds its own price drops for 30 days
stores.scope: If Costco lowers the price on something you bought, it will refund the difference. Warehouse and Costco.com prices are separate.
stores.after: 30 days from the day you buy, while the item is still at the lower price.
stores.how: In the warehouse: membership counter with your card. Online: Order History, then the price adjustment form.
no: Warehouse price for an online order (and the other way)

stores.name: Sam's Club
stores.short: No competitor matching. Some clubs match other Sam's Clubs
stores.scope: Sam's doesn't match other stores. Depending on the club, a manager may match a lower price at another Sam's Club.
stores.after: No set policy. Ask a manager.
stores.how: Ask a manager at the club.
no: Clearance and markdowns from another club

stores.name: Amazon
stores.scope: Amazon doesn't match other stores' prices or refund price drops.
stores.how: Tip: Best Buy, Home Depot, Lowe's and Staples will match Amazon's price when it's sold by Amazon.

stores.name: Sephora
stores.short: Only matches full-price beauty at a few department stores
stores.scope: Non-sale in-store prices at those four stores only, at the time you buy.
stores.after: No price adjustments after you buy.

stores.name: Ulta Beauty
stores.scope: Ulta doesn't publish a price match policy.
stores.how: Use Ulta Rewards points and coupons instead.

stores.name: Aldi
stores.scope: No official price match. Some managers may adjust case by case.
